decisions.thought: Opponent: Garchomp/Toxapex/Weavile/Tyranitar/Volcarona/Greninja. I'll bring Garchomp, Kingambit, Primarina? Weavile threatens both Garchomp and... Primarina resists Ice? Water/Fairy: Ice neutral? Water resists Ice, Fairy neutral → resisted. Primarina good vs Weavile. Kingambit weak to... Weavile's Low Kick/Knock Off? Fighting 4x? Kingambit Dark/Steel: Fighting 4x, Fire, Ground. Weavile usually Ice/Dark moves + maybe Low Kick. Hmm.
